title: Dot Boxes
description: The game you used to play on the back of a notebook. Take turns drawing lines between dots. Close a box and it's yours, and you go again. The trick is never drawing the third side of a box, because that's a gift for whoever goes next.
instructions: Click (or tap) between two dots to draw a line. Keyboard: arrow keys to move, Space to draw. Play the CPU or take turns with a friend.
